line.en: the flea market on campo de santa clara is open tuesdays and saturdays, roughly 09:00 to 18:00. most stalls pack up around 14:00, so go in the morning.
line.de: der flohmarkt auf dem campo de santa clara hat dienstags und samstags offen, etwa 9 bis 18 uhr. die meisten stände packen gegen 14 uhr ein, also lieber vormittags.
line.tr: campo de santa clara'daki pire pazarı salı ve cumartesi, yaklaşık 09:00-18:00 açık. çoğu tezgâh 14:00 civarı kapanır, o yüzden sabah en iyisi.

sparks.why: Feira da Ladra, Campo de Santa Clara, runs tuesdays and saturdays per the Câmara de Lisboa directory (informacoeseservicos.lisboa.pt) and local guides in search; hours from the guides.
